title: Modeling Cellular Signaling Variability Based on Single-Cell Data: The TGFbeta-SMAD Signaling Pathway.
authors: Sarma, Uddipan; Ripka, Lorenz; Anyaegbunam, Uchenna Alex; Legewie, Stefan
one_liner_zh: 该文综述基于单细胞数据的TGFbeta-SMAD信号通路异质性建模，聚焦细胞信号传导而非蛋白质-DNA互作，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Nongenetic heterogeneity is key to cellular decisions, as even genetically identical cells respond in very different ways to the same external stimulus, e.g., during cell differentiation or therapeutic treatment of disease. Strong heterogeneity is typically already observed at the level of signaling pathways that are the first sensors of external inputs and transmit information to the nucleus where decisions are made. Since heterogeneity arises from random fluctuations of cellular components, mathematical models are required to fully describe the phenomenon and to understand the dynamics of heterogeneous cell populations. Here, we review the experimental and theoretical literature on cellular signaling heterogeneity, with special focus on the TGFbeta/SMAD signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 非遗传异质性对细胞决策至关重要，因为即使是基因相同的细胞，在面对相同外部刺激时也会表现出截然不同的反应，例如在细胞分化或疾病治疗过程中。强烈的异质性通常已在信号通路层面被观察到，这些通路是外部输入的首个传感器，并将信息传递至做出决策的细胞核。由于异质性源于细胞组分的随机波动，因此需要数学模型来全面描述这一现象，并理解异质性细胞群体的动态行为。在此，我们回顾了关于细胞信号异质性的实验和理论文献，特别关注TGFβ/SMAD信号通路。
